title: file v. path in read_csv()
description: It's correct in [the Rmd](https://github.com/rstudio/master-the-tidyverse/blob/master/04-Import-Data.Rmd), but in [the slides](https://github.com/rstudio/master-the-tidyverse/blob/master/pdfs/04-Import-Data.pdf) it still says `write_csv(nimbus, file = "nimbus2.csv")` (should be `path=`)
